products_view_all_description: Every SKU in a connected catalog, one row per SKU with each source side by side.
products_view_differs_description: SKUs whose sources disagree on title, status, sales channel, price, or barcode.
products_view_missing_description: SKUs that at least one catalog source doesn’t list. Some items are sold or managed in one system only on purpose.
products_view_unlinked_description: SKUs with a same-code SKU in another source that isn’t linked yet. Link them if they’re the same item.
products_state_all_sources: {count, plural, one {Listed in {count, number} source} other {Listed in all {count, number} sources}}
products_gap_match: {source} has a SKU with the same code ({code}) that isn’t linked to this one.
products_gap_unread: {source} doesn’t list this SKU in what Luma has read so far. Luma hasn’t read its full catalog yet.
products_gap_absent: {source} doesn’t list this SKU. Luma read its full catalog {time}.
products_listing_in_products: {count, plural, one {In {count, number} product} other {In {count, number} products}}
products_list_search_placeholder: SKU, title, barcode, vendor, or source ID…
products_list_note: Luma doesn’t treat any source as the authority. Prices are compared only within the same currency.
products_list_offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to refresh products.
products_list_refresh_failed: Luma couldn’t refresh products. The list below may be out of date.
products_list_caption: {view}, with each source’s listing side by side
products_list_view_empty: No SKUs in “{view}”. Your catalogs agree for this view.
products_list_unmatched_body: Try another SKU, title, or source.
products_list_empty_body: Products appear here once a connected store or ERP shares its catalog. Check Data sync for progress.
products_list_count: {shown, number} of {total, plural, one {{total, number} SKU} other {{total, number} SKUs}}
products_list_count_page: {shown, number} on this page, {total, plural, one {{total, number} SKU} other {{total, number} SKUs}} in total
products_gaps_add: If it should be sold or managed in {source}, add it there. Luma doesn’t create listings.
products_gaps_add_generic: If it should be sold or managed in that source, add it there. Luma doesn’t create listings.
products_detail_no_title: No source reports a title for this SKU.
products_detail_description_fallback: Compare listings by source and see what depends on this SKU.
products_detail_offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to refresh this product.
products_detail_missing_body: This SKU doesn’t exist in this workspace, or it was linked into another SKU.
products_detail_refresh_failed: Luma couldn’t refresh this product. The details below may be out of date.
products_detail_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load this product. Check your connection and try again.
products_explanation_agree: How each source lists this SKU
products_explanation_agree_body: Reported values agree. Agreement doesn’t make any source the authority.
products_explanation_no_catalog_body: Luma knows this SKU from stock or order lines, but no connected catalog lists it.
products_explanation_method: Titles are compared ignoring case, spacing, and punctuation. Prices are compared only within the same currency.
products_stock_note: Available quantity per source. Quantities from different sources are never added together.
products_stock_empty: Luma hasn’t read any stock for this SKU.
products_sales_note: Units ordered by date placed, minus reported cancellations. Shown per source, because several systems can hold the same order.
products_sales_empty: No orders with a placed date in the last 30 days.
products_orders_empty: No orders Luma has read include this SKU.
products_supply_note: Purchase order quantities aren’t confirmed incoming stock.
products_supply_empty: No purchase orders for this SKU.
products_issues_empty: No issues recorded for this SKU or its stock.
products_variants_note: SKUs of the same product in each source.
products_variants_empty: This SKU is the only variant of its product.
products_related_truncated: Showing the first 50 entries for each kind of related record. Open Orders, Inventory, or Procurement to see more.
products_history_note: Catalog readings Luma recorded, newest first. A reading shows what the source reported at that time, not necessarily a change at the source.
products_history_truncated: {count, plural, one {Showing the most recent reading.} other {Showing the {count, number} most recent readings.}}
products_sales_summary: {quantity} {unit} in {orders, plural, one {{orders, number} order} other {{orders, number} orders}}
products_sales_chart_label: {source}: {summary} in the last 30 days, peaking at {peak} {unit} in one day.
